Permit status such as 'Signed-off' is a permit lifecycle field and should not be treated as a certificate of occupancy. Source-reported cost, floor-area, unit, height, story, use, and status fields can be amended by later DOB records. Coordinates are DOB/Open Data geocoded address points, not surveyed parcels, entrances, building footprints, or work limits.
candidates.transformation_method: Round493 queried official NYC Open Data DOB NOW approved permit rows (rbx6-tga4) for 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-20, joined retained permit rows to DOB NOW job application filing rows (w9ak-ipjd), kept one nonduplicate architecture-signal administrative permit row per base DOB NOW job, and preserved row-level permit/application provenance. Duplicate scope: manual corpus plus prior DOB administrative candidate packs through Round484.
candidates.duplicate_check_note: Exact event_id, source URL/record ID, DOB NOW job/permit/tracking identifiers, source-date tokens, and title/date/site keys were screened against the manual corpus plus NYC DOB NOW/DOB permit/DOB CO candidate packs through Round484.
